name: cdd-knowledge-pipeline
description: CDD/NCDD ABAP knowledge crawl pipeline for /HEC1/CP_CDD and /HEC1/CP_NCDD

scripts.setup-cron: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const cmd='0 6 * * 1 cd $(pwd) && node pipeline/weekly-sync.js >> logs/sync.log 2>&1';execSync('(crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo \"'+cmd+'\") | crontab -');console.log('Cron job added: every Monday 6am');"
